blocks.text: Sulfur bohat se elements se mil kar inorganic aur organic compounds ki wasee qismein banati hai. Yeh aam halaat mein pani, dilute non-oxidising acids aur noble gases ki taraf ghair-reactive hai, aur catenate karne ki salahiyat use halqe aur seedhi zanjeerein banane deti hai.

items: Sulfur hawa mein neele sholay se jal kar SO2 banati hai; doosra bunyadi oxide SO3 zyada darja hararat aur catalyst mangta hai: S + O2 se SO2; 2SO2 + O2 Pt par 2SO3. Nitric acid sulfur ko NO2 aur sulfuric acid mein oxidise karta hai: S + 6HNO3 se H2SO4 + 6NO2 + 2H2O.

Kam electronegativity wale elements ke saath sulfur oxidising agent ka kaam karti aur sulfides banati hai; yeh Ag, Cu aur Zn ko metal sulfide ki tah se dhundla karti hai (2Ag + S se Ag2S; Hg + S se HgS; 2Cu + S se Cu2S) magar Au ya Pt se react nahi karti.
Sulfur cyanide ko thiocyanate mein badalti hai, ek pseudohalide jo Fe3+ ke tajziye mein istemal hota hai: KCN + S se KSCN.

Sulfur fluorine se seedha react kar ke SF4 aur SF6 deti hai; sulfur hexafluoride bohat ghair-reactive gas hai jo bijli ke aalaat mein insulator ke taur par istemal hoti hai (S + 3F2 se SF6). Yeh chlorine se aasani se react kar ke S2Cl2 (peela liquid) deti hai, jo aage SCl2 (surkh liquid) mein react karta hai: 2S + Cl2 se S2Cl2.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur halogens se, aur HCl aur NaOH se, kaise react karti hai (exercise Q.2i; Quick Check 12.5b)?
blocks.explanation: Fluorine se woh jal kar SF4 aur SF6 deti hai, hexafluoride inert insulating gas hai; chlorine se peela S2Cl2 aur phir surkh SCl2. Sulfur dilute non-oxidising HCl se react nahi karti. Garam ghaliz NaOH se woh sulfide aur thiosulfate mein disproportionate hoti hai: 4S + 6NaOH se 2Na2S + Na2S2O3 + 3H2O.

items: S jal kar SO2 (SO3 ko Pt aur garmi chahiye); HNO3 H2SO4 + NO2 deta hai; Ag, Cu, Zn, Hg ke saath sulfides (Au, Pt nahi); KCN se KSCN; F2 se SF6 (inert), Cl2 se S2Cl2 aur SCl2; pani, dilute acids, noble gases ki taraf inert.
